headline: Accellera releases UVM-MS 1.0 with participation from six tracked companies
fact: On February 4, 2025, Accellera released UVM-MS 1.0, defining mixed-signal bridge and proxy components for driving and monitoring mixed-signal nets. The standard's participant list names active contributors from Cadence, Siemens EDA, Synopsys, NXP, Qualcomm, and Renesas; participation in the standard does not by itself establish deployment at those companies.
